snippet.title: 👠 Wylde Society 👠 | First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
We hope you adore this first look at our new game ‘Wylde Society’. 

As development continues, we will have more news to come like platform announcements, more game features, release dates and more! Join our mailing list for news! 👀

✨ WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036260/Wylde_Society/ 

💖 JOIN OUR MAILING LIST HERE: https://subscribepage.io/studiodrydockmailinglist 

PLEASE NOTE: This title is still in active development, so aspects of what you see in this video may be altered in the final version of Wylde Society

✨ Game Description ✨
Step into the elegant heels of Vivian Wylde, witch, socialite and host, in period drama sim Wylde Society! Build, run and customise your magical boarding house in turn of the century Fairhaven. Host splendid events, expand your witchcraft, and influence the town. Who will you invite for tea?

Find us here:
Website - https://www.wyldesociety.com/ 
Discord - https://discord.com/invite/ksAqre83M
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/studiodrydock 
Reddit - https://www.reddit.com/r/WyldeSociety/ 
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@studiodrydock 

🍃 Developed by: Studio Drydock 🍃
https://studiodrydock.com/
